# temps_service_types (Data Source)

Lists the service types the Temps server can run. Needs the `external_services:read` permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "temps_service_types" "all" {}

output "service_types" {
  value = data.temps_service_types.all.types
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `service_types`.
- `types` (List of String) Service type names.
